BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Wagoner, Warnick, Bailey, Honeyford, and Van De Wege

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Agriculture, Water, Natural Resources & Parks.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of natural resources to maintain the department's roads that are the exclusive means of accessing private property by road.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the department of natural resources to maintain the department's roads that are the exclusive means of accessing private property by road; and adding a new section to chapter 79.38 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 79.38 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department shall maintain any road under its ownership or control that has been the exclusive means of accessing private property by road for a continuous period of at least ten years. The duty imposed on the department under this section terminates if the property that is made accessible by a road under the department's ownership or control ceases to be privately owned.
